about: What PathDetectors finds for runner.executor (spec section 8): the candidate programs in order of preference, and the verified executor entry for each one that has one. A candidate with no template (codex: no verified argv exists for it) is found but yields no executor, so the caller is told to set one by hand rather than being handed a guess. The claude template equals the claude-cli invocation of the runner standard; a test pins the two.
